title: Mishlove's prize-winning Bigelow essay on survival of consciousness

tellings.quote: Bigalow asked for an essay on the strongest evidence that human consciousness will survive permanent bodily death.

plain: In 2021 the businessman Robert Bigelow held an essay contest through his Bigelow Institute, asking for "the strongest evidence that human consciousness will survive permanent bodily death," and the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove says his entry won a prize. Mishlove tells it himself, as someone who wrote one of the winning essays arguing that the mind lives on after death.
